name: nullInvoice
description: Automated invoice generation with customizable HTML templates for webstores and SaaS integration. For the full documentation of this project, available in six languages, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your UTC TZ offset for database timestamp recording. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/blob/main/docs/extended/DEPLOYMENT.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_NAME
variables.description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullInvoice/blob/main/docs/extended/DEPLOYMENT.md#database-setup

variables.name: DB_PARAMS
variables.description: Additional database connection string parameters. Make sure to set a value for serverTimezone matching your TZ variable setting.

variables.name: QUEUE_ENABLED
variables.description: Master switch for the async invoice generation worker. Set to false to disable the background poller. Default: true.
